chunks: And from him, from ʿAbbād ibn Sulaymān, from Saʿd ibn Saʿd, from Ṣafwān, from Abī al-Ḥasan عليه السلام, who said:
"If you do not know how much you have prayed, and your conjecture does not settle upon anything, then repeat the salat (prayer)."

key_terms.كَمْ صَلَّيْتَ: how much of the salat (prayer) you have performed
key_terms.لَا تَدْرِي: you do not know or are uncertain

ai.seo_question: What should one do if one completely loses track of how much salat (prayer) has been performed?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding doubt in salat (prayer). If a person becomes unsure about the number of units prayed and no probable assumption forms in his mind, he must repeat the salat (prayer).
